mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_user_account ( user_id, username, password_hash, roles, enabled, default_org_id, balance, membership_level, points, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{roles}, #{enabled}, #{defaultOrgId}, 0, 'NORMAL', 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, username, password_hash, roles, enabled, default_org_id, created_at, updated_at FROM biz_user_account ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
